div.head: List of Sources

item.hi: Department of State

list.item:
Central Files
Decimal files of the Department of State.

Bundy Files: Lot 85 D 240
Files of William P. Bundy for the 1960’s.

Conference Files: Lot 65 D 366
Collection of documentation on official visits by heads of government and foreign ministers to the United States and on major international conferences attended by the Secretary of State, as maintained by the Executive Secretariat of the Department of State.

G/PM Files: Lot 64 D 354
Miscellaneous top secret subject files maintained by the Combined Policy Staff of the Office of Politico-Military Affairs for 1954-1961.

INR-NIE Files
Files retained by the Bureau of Intelligence and Research containing copies of the National Intelligence Estimates and Special National Intelligence Estimates including NIE’s and SNIE’s for 1961.

Johnson Files
Subject files of U. Alexis Johnson for various positions held in the 1960’s. Scheduled for transfer to the Lyndon B. Johnson Library.

Presidential Correspondence: Lot 66 D 204
Exchanges of correspondence between the President and the heads of foreign governments for 1953-1964, as maintained by the Executive Secretariat of the Department of State.

Presidential Correspondence: Lot 66 D 476
Correspondence of the President with various heads of state, 1961-1966.

Presidential Correspondence: Lot 77 D 163
Correspondence of Presidents Kennedy and Johnson with the Chairman of the Soviet Union, the Prime Minister of Great Britain, and the President of France, 1961-1964.

Rusk Files: Lot 72 D 192
Files of Secretary of State Dean Rusk, 1961-1969, including texts of speeches and public statements, miscellaneous correspondence files, White House correspondence, chronological files, and memoranda of telephone conversations.

S/P Files: Lot 67 D 548
Subject files, country files, chronological files, documents, drafts, and related correspondence of the Policy Planning Staff for 1957-1961.

S/S-NSC Files: Lot 70 D 265
Master set of papers pertaining to National Security Council meetings, including policy papers, position papers, administrative documents, but not minutes of the meetings themselves, for 1961-1966, as maintained by the Executive Secretariat.

S/S-NSC Files: Lot 72 D 316
Master file of National Security Action Memoranda (NSAMs), 1961-1968.

S/S-NSC (Miscellaneous) Files: Lot 66 D 95
Administrative and miscellaneous National Security Council documentation, including NSC Records of Action as maintained by the Executive Secretariat for 1947-1963.

Secretary’s Memoranda of Conversation: Lot 65 D 330
Memoranda of the Secretary’s and Under Secretary’s conversations, 1961-1964.

Vietnam Working Group Files: Lot 66 D 193
Files of the interagency Vietnam Working Group, 1960-1962.

Lansdale Files: FRC 63 A 1803
Subject and country files of Edward G. Lansdale, Deputy Assistant and Assistant to the Secretary of Defense (Special Operations), 1957-1961.

McNamara Files: FRC 71 A 3470
Files of Secretary of Defense Robert McNamara, 1961-1968.

OASD/ISA Files:FRC 64 A 2382
General and country files of the Assistant Secretary of Defense for International Security Affairs for 1961.

OSD Files: FRC 65 A 3078
Miscellaneous files of the Secretary of Defense, Deputy Secretary of Defense, their aides, and the Administrative Secretary to the Secretary of Defense, 1953-1963, and personal files of Donald A. Quarles predating his service as Deputy Secretary of Defense (prior to August 15, 1955).

OSD Files: FRC 66 A 3542
Records of the Secretary and Deputy Secretary of Defense and their Special Assistants, 1962.

OSD Files: FRC 71 A 6489
Miscellaneous records of the Secretary of Defense, the Deputy Secretary of Defense, and their assistants, 1951-1966.

OSD Files: FRC 77-131
Miscellaneous records pertaining to Cuba, Vietnam, Laos, Berlin, Soviet weapons, and the Republic of China, 1962-1972.
